modules:
  komga:
    headers:
      X-API-Key: "{{ .KOMGA_API_KEY }}"
    metrics:
      - name: komga_actuator
        type: object
        help: Spring Boot Actuator measurement scraped from Komga
        path: '{.measurements[*]}'
        labels:
          statistic: '{.statistic}'
        values:
          value: '{.value}'
  komga-page:

      X-API-Key: "{{ .KOMGA_API_KEY }}"

        type: value
        help: Books Komga has indexed in this library
        path: '{.totalElements}'

#!/bin/sh
# Health-check the SLZB-06 Zigbee coordinator; if it is fully
# unresponsive (ESP32 lockup — HTTP port down), power-cycle its
# UniFi PoE port to force a hard reboot. A soft HTTP reboot cannot
# recover a full lockup, only a power cut can.
set -eu

n=0
while [ "$n" -lt "${CHECKS}" ]; do
  n=$((n + 1))
  if curl -sf -m 5 -o /dev/null "${COORD_URL}"; then
    echo "$(date -u +%FT%TZ) coordinator reachable on attempt ${n}/${CHECKS} — OK"
    exit 0
  fi
  echo "$(date -u +%FT%TZ) coordinator unreachable (${n}/${CHECKS})"
  [ "$n" -lt "${CHECKS}" ] && sleep "${INTERVAL}"
done

echo "$(date -u +%FT%TZ) coordinator down after ${CHECKS} checks — power-cycling PoE port ${PORT_IDX}"
code=$(curl -sk -m 20 -o /tmp/resp.json -w '%{http_code}' -X POST \
  -H "X-API-KEY: ${UNIFI_API_KEY}" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"action":"POWER_CYCLE"}' \
  "${UNIFI_HOST}/proxy/network/integration/v1/sites/${SITE_ID}/devices/${DEVICE_ID}/interfaces/ports/${PORT_IDX}/actions")
echo "power-cycle response HTTP ${code}: $(cat /tmp/resp.json 2>/dev/null || true)"
case "${code}" in
  2*) echo "power-cycle issued successfully"; exit 0 ;;
  *) echo "power-cycle FAILED"; exit 1 ;;
esac

url: "https://{{ .Release.Name }}.dcunha.io"
conditions: ["[STATUS] == 401"]
ui:
  hide-hostname: true
  hide-url: true

while true; do
  if [ -f "$CRASH_LOG" ] && [ "$(stat -c %s "$CRASH_LOG")" -gt "$MAX_BYTES" ]; then
    : > "$CRASH_LOG"
    echo "truncated $CRASH_LOG"
  fi
  sleep 60
done

[INPUT]
  name tcp
  alias talos
  listen 0.0.0.0
  port 5170
  format json
  tag talos.*
  chunk_size 32
  buffer_size 256

[FILTER]
  name record_modifier
  match talos.*
  record node ${NODE_NAME}
  record collector talos-logs

[OUTPUT]
  name http
  match talos.*
  host victoria-logs-server.observability.svc.cluster.local
  port 9428
  uri /insert/jsonline?_stream_fields=node,collector,facility,talos-service&_msg_field=msg&_time_field=talos-time
  format json_lines
  json_date_format iso8601
  compress gzip
  log_response_payload false
